industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: EarthRenew Inc.
summary: EarthRenew Inc. produces and sells organic fertilizers from livestock waste in North America and Europe. It also produces electricity from natural gas using an industrial-sized gas turbine to electrical grid and cryptocurrency miners. The company sells it fertilizers under GrowER and GrowER Biochar names. The company is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
